title: Interprocess Data Channel
text: Model interprocessor data channel between two processors, 1 input, 4 outputs; {Circular FIFO depth} sets the number of storage buffers, {Propagation delay}, {Show event port} sets the option to enable task event ports, {Show number of used circular FIFO} sets the option to enable circular FIFO count ports and {Show when circular FIFO is overwritten} enables port that shows circular FIFO. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: used
ports.summary: Output number of buffers in use scalar

params.name: Circular FIFO depth
params.values: Number of storage buffers 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Propagation delay
params.values: Propagation delay of data through the channel 1e-6 (default) | non-negative number

params.name: Show event port
params.values: Option to enable task event ports off (default) | on

params.name: Show number of used circular FIFO
params.values: Option to enable circular FIFO count ports off (default) | on

params.name: Show when circular FIFO is overwritten
params.values: Enable port that shows circular FIFO overwrites off (default) | on
